profile_text.body:
Cerebras is an AI hardware and infrastructure company founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco. The company describes itself as powering the world's fastest AI inference on what it calls the biggest wafer chip. Its flagship product, the Cerebras CS-4, is presented as a rack-scale solution that delivers up to 30x faster inference compared to GPUs and is designed for hyperscale deployment as infrastructure for frontier AI.

The company offers wafer-scale compute hardware, an inference API, and on-premises deployment options. Cerebras describes its CS-4 as targeting the latency bottleneck in AI inference workloads. Partners and customers cited on the company's site include OpenAI, GSK, Notion, and LiveKit, with use cases spanning real-time AI features, drug discovery, enterprise search, and AI agents. One quoted partner describes a cancer-drug response prediction model running many hundreds of times faster on Cerebras hardware than on conventional GPUs.

The held facts confirm Cerebras has been tracked since at least the profile verification date of August 31, 2026, with its primary product categorized under Chat and General LLMs, reflecting its inference API and high-performance computing offerings. No litigation or MCP server registrations are on record for the company.
